canonical.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of L'Eau Vive

parent.title: Weekend in Arbre, anchored on L'Eau Vive

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near L'Eau Vive
siblings.summary: Le Cube — the restaurant's own riverside cottage — is the only true walking-distance stay; every other option is a 3–4 km taxi ride.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of L'Eau Vive
siblings.summary: Fifty-plus stops within 30 km of L'Eau Vive grouped by traveler type: castles, abbeys, Lesse kayaks, caves, Plus Beaux Villages, distilleries and brewery food stops.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of L'Eau Vive
siblings.summary: KIKK Festival (21–25 Oct 2026, Namur) is the anchor IT event; plus year-round digital programming at Le Pavillon, TRAKK and Charleroi's A6K hub.

sources.title: L'Eau Vive (official)
sources.claim: L'Eau Vive operates two on-site guesthouses, Espace Médissey and Le Cube, at Route de Floreffe 37, 5170 Rivière (Profondeville)
